mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plugin_account_list_preference (user_id, installation_id, selected_fields_json) VALUES (#{userId}, #{installationId}, CAST(#{selectedFieldsJson} AS JSON)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE selected_fields_json = VALUES(selected_fields_json), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
